## Summary
"Jabil Circuit de Chihuahua" is the IEEE registrant name on a single MA-L block, D0:C3:5A, registered 24 July 2021 with a care-of address at Space Border Logistics in El Paso, Texas, i.e. a cross-border freight forwarder rather than the plant itself [1][2]. The plant is Jabil's Chihuahua, Mexico site at Alejandro Dumas Av 11341, Complejo Industrial Chihuahua, one of five Jabil manufacturing locations in Mexico; Jabil's own entity list spells it "Jabil Circuit Chihuahua, S. de R.L. de C.V" [4][5]. Jabil Inc. is a St. Petersburg, Florida electronics manufacturing services (EMS) company founded in 1966 that builds circuit-board assemblies and finished systems for other brands in 30 countries, so a MAC in this block is a product Jabil assembled for a customer, not a Jabil-branded device [3]. Other Jabil sites register their own blocks under their own names (Jabil Circuit, Inc.; Jabil Circuit (Guangzhou) Limited; Jabil Circuit (Shanghai) Ltd.; Jabil Circuit Penang; Jabil Circuit Hungary Ltd.; Jabil circuit italia srl; Jabil Inc; Jabil), which are separate registrations rather than spellings of this one, and a community device-type database groups D0:C3:5A with the other Jabil blocks under "Jabil Circuit, Inc." [1][6]. No public documentation found for which customer product carries D0:C3:5A: no teardown, FCC filing or inventory naming the end product was reachable. Radios, silicon, FCC grantee (an EMS normally certifies under the brand's grantee code) and MAC randomization are therefore unknown; the founding year of the Chihuahua entity is not stated in the sources (parent Jabil: 1966 [3]).
